open_points: The chase picker that chooses the landmark on the route ahead is the one-shot's (the route is map.json's driving graph); these are the words only.
Ron's three-beat lines are written once per landmark here; his own-line voice for the rest is TO WRITE in own-ron_kirby.json.
note: Landmark direction lines: whoever rides with Frank says the way by landmark (no marker). 'passenger' means Ron, a crewman or a fare who knows the town; Ron's own form is the three-beat one. once never: these repeat by design and are chosen so the landmark named is on the route ahead. At least one a 20 s of chase (GV-03).
